content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for DMF Jajpur Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the District Mineral Foundation Jajpur (DMF Jajpur) in the state of Odisha for healthcare professionals.

faq.question: Q2. What are the total vacancies available under DMF Jajpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 12 vacancies available for various Specialist and GDMO posts across different medical departments under this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for DMF Jajpur Doctors Recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly Walk-in. Eligible candidates do not need to apply online; they can directly appear for the interview at the designated venue.

faq.question: Q4. What is the scheduled date for the Walk-in-Interview?
faq.answer: The Walk-in-Interview is scheduled to be held on 22 October 2026 at 10 AM at the Collectorate Conference Hall, Jajpur.

faq.question: Q5. What is the minimum educational qualification required for Specialists?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree from a recognized institute approved by the Medical Council of India along with a Post Graduate degree in the relevant medical specialization.

faq.question: Q6. What is the upper age limit to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for all posts under the DMF Jajpur recruitment is 70 years as specified in the official notification guidelines.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary or remuneration offered for Specialists?
faq.answer: Specialists will receive ₹ 25,000/- per visit (negotiable based on experience) with a minimum requirement of two visits per week, while GDMOs get ₹80,000 and above.

faq.question: Q8. What documents are required to be brought to the Walk-in-Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring all requisite educational and professional documents, valid identity proof in original, along with two sets of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the Walk-in-Interview take place?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at the Collectorate Conference Hall, 2nd Floor, Collectorate, Jajpur, Odisha, starting at 10 AM on the scheduled date.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for attending this walk-in interview?
faq.answer: No application fee is required or mentioned in the official notification for attending the DMF Jajpur Walk-in-Interview 2026.
